title: Explicit source-provider authentication for fleet Gitea mirrors
intended_behavior: The initiator selects GitHub or private Gitea only from authoritative configuration and never guesses from a clone URL.
GitHub retains token migration while private Gitea uses provider-neutral git migration with configured username and the resolved opaque credential as password.
Clone URLs remain credential-free HTTPS values and are compared with Gitea original_url before any existing mirror is trusted.
Gitea API failures include a scrubbed, bounded response excerpt without exposing source or fleet credentials.
